priceUnit: Rappen (integer; 1 CHF = 100 Rappen); VAT included as printed
priceFormat: rendered by one formatter as «CHF 12.90» (currency code, narrow no-break space U+202F, decimal point, two decimals) in all four languages
languages: Names and descriptions DE (and FR where the PDF prints it) are the restaurant's wording; EN and IT are translations for this site. nameInvariant marks names kept in their original language in every locale.

verification.ocr+visual: scanned page (no text layer): transcribed visually from the 300-dpi render and confirmed by Tesseract OCR (all prices and ≥ 85 % of the German words found on that page)
verification.text-layer+visual: page with a PDF text layer (Frisco template): transcribed visually and confirmed by the text layer
verification.visual: transcribed visually; the machine reading did not confirm every word or price (see machineReading) – checked against the render

confidence.high: machine reading and visual transcription agree
confidence.low: the printed menu itself leaves something open (unresolved, see content/menu-review.md)

footnotes.it: Il nostro pane arriva ogni giorno dalla panetteria la Bohème di Leukerbad (CH).

footnotes.de: Den Pizzateig stellen wir täglich vor Ort frisch mit regionalen Zutaten her.
footnotes.en: We make our pizza dough fresh on site every day, with regional ingredients.
footnotes.fr: Nous préparons chaque jour sur place la pâte à pizza fraîche, à partir d’ingrédients régionaux.
footnotes.it: Prepariamo ogni giorno sul posto l’impasto fresco della pizza, con ingredienti regionali.

footnotes.de: Unser Fisch ist von der Firma Dyhrberg mit zertifiziertem Anbau, Meeresfrüchte aus Vietnam oder Thailand und Rauchlachs aus Norwegen.
footnotes.en: Our fish comes from Dyhrberg, from certified farming; seafood from Vietnam or Thailand and smoked salmon from Norway.
footnotes.fr: Notre poisson provient de l’entreprise Dyhrberg, d’élevage certifié; fruits de mer du Vietnam ou de Thaïlande et saumon fumé de Norvège.
footnotes.it: Il nostro pesce proviene dalla ditta Dyhrberg, da allevamento certificato; frutti di mare dal Vietnam o dalla Thailandia e salmone affumicato dalla Norvegia.

footnotes.de: Bei Allergien wenden Sie sich bitte an die Servicemitarbeiter. Danke.

footnotes.it: In caso di allergie, rivolgetevi al nostro personale di servizio. Grazie.

review.question: «Gemischter Salat vom Büffet» shows two prices (CHF 12.00 and CHF 21.50) without labels. Are these a small and a large plate? The site shows both prices as printed.
«Hugo Sprizz, Grapefr’izz» is one line with one price (CHF 11.50, 17 % vol). Is that the price of each of the two drinks?
«Sirup Kids»: CHF 1.00 for 2 dl and CHF 3.00 for 3 dl, as printed. Please confirm.
«Kaffee GIARDINO» and «Alpen Glüh» have no description on the menu. A short description could be added.

The food menu prints «Servieren wir von 11.30 bis 14.00 und von 17.00 bis 21.00 Uhr» for the meat dishes; the website says «Warme Küche von 11:30 bis 15:00 Uhr und 17:00 bis 21:30 Uhr». The website is the source for hours, so the menu line is not shown. Are the meat-course hours still valid, and should they be shown?

The dessert menu marks the apricot, lemon and raspberry sorbets VEGAN; the kids leaflet lists the same flavours without the mark. The site shows the mark on the dessert menu only. Are the sorbets vegan in both cases?

«Hausgemachter Ice Tee» (3 dl, 5 dl), «Rivella rot» (3 dl, 1 l) and «Rivella blau» (3 dl) fill only part of the size matrix of their page. The site shows the printed prices; are other sizes available?

Only printed markers are shown: «Hausgemacht», origin (CH / AUS), Dyhrberg fish, VEGAN on three sorbets and «Mocca – enthält Haselnuss». Coupes that contain Mocca ice cream are not marked; no spicy or dietary markers are derived from descriptions.

The website title calls Giardino a «Glutenfreie Pizzeria» and shows the IG Zöliakie «ohne Gluten» logo (2014), but no menu marks gluten-free dishes. Which dishes can be served gluten-free, and is the 2014 certification still valid?
No menu lists allergens per dish (besides «Mocca enthält Haselnuss»). Guests are asked to tell the service team, as on the printed menu.
